scenarios.testName: canonical Provider Execution authority consequences remain non-authoritative for legal appointment, payment, filing and Official Truth
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Provider execution vocabulary and authority consequences remain frozen and machine-tested

scenarios.testName: owns and verifies MGSN migrations 0028 through 0031
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Provider Registry, Service Package, Allocation and Provider Return migrations are owner-scoped and verified

scenarios.testName: owns and verifies the Execution evidence migration without weakening prior ownership
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Execution 0032 evidence migration is verified alongside prior Execution-owned schema

scenarios.testName: fails closed when Execution source becomes stale after Eligibility Evaluation
scenarios.expectedEvidence: A stale governed Execution source cannot become an active Allocation

scenarios.testName: serializes concurrent competing Allocation commands so only one becomes active
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Concurrent competing commands produce one active Allocation and one controlled conflict

scenarios.testName: creates one explicit Allocation only from exact current ELIGIBLE truth and replays identically
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Identical Allocation command replay is deterministic and does not create duplicate active truth

scenarios.testName: binds Provider response to authenticated Provider Workspace identity and rejects spoofing
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Provider Acceptance identity comes from the authenticated Provider Workspace and spoofing fails closed

scenarios.testName: decline preserves Allocation history and permits only explicit reallocation
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Declined Allocation versions remain durable and reallocation is a new explicit command

scenarios.testName: creates an authenticated evidence-only return and replays identically
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Provider Return provenance, exact lineage and idempotent replay survive repository reconstruction

scenarios.testName: corrections explicitly supersede the exact current Provider Return while preserving prior versions
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Provider Return correction is additive, versioned and historical evidence remains durable

scenarios.testName: persists one exact reviewable receipt and replays identically after response loss
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Exact Provider Return ID/version/fingerprint handoff produces one retry-safe PENDING_REVIEW receipt

scenarios.testName: fails closed on stale return, changed fingerprint, source mismatch and cross-workspace input
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Stale/superseded Provider Return or Execution lineage cannot create evidence truth
Provider Return evidence audit rows reject mutation

scenarios.testName: trusted MGSN HTTP boundary rejects untrusted caller, cross-Workspace operations and cross-Provider reads
scenarios.requiredMode: trusted internal service secret + Workspace Principal
scenarios.expectedEvidence: MGSN independently revalidates caller and Principal and does not enumerate other Provider Workspaces

scenarios.testName: authenticated Gateway provider journey enforces session, permission, Origin/CSRF, provider identity and idempotency boundaries
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Browser-facing operations/provider commands reach MGSN only through authenticated controlled transport

scenarios.testName: fails closed with controlled 503 responses when MGSN transport or internal authorization is unavailable
scenarios.expectedEvidence: MGSN outage/configuration failure is redacted, typed and non-mutating

scenarios.testName: second-cycle Allocation, Provider Return and Execution evidence suites run against the same owner databases
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Critical durable suites pass a second cycle without leaked state or non-repeatable migration assumptions
